0022600016.text: The Boston Celtics (3-1, 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back) host the Chicago Bulls (1-3, 4th in the Central, 2.5 games back) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, the fifth of the season for Boston. Boston is 3-0 at home and on a three-game winning streak, while Chicago, 11th in the East, has lost its last two games. Devin Carter is out for the Celtics with an illness, and the Bulls are missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), Patrick Williams (groin soreness) and Tobe Awaka (ankle). Boston leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 134-99 win in Boston on October 26, and the Celtics also won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
